definitions.gloss: bad harvest; crop failure; poor yield
definitions.explanation: A significantly poor agricultural harvest, typically caused by adverse weather conditions such as drought, flooding, cold spells, or pest damage.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{米|こめ}が{凶作|きょうさく}だった。
examples.english: This year's rice harvest was poor.

examples.japanese: {冷夏|れいか}の{影響|えいきょう}で{凶作|きょうさく}になった。
examples.english: The cool summer caused a crop failure.

examples.japanese: {凶作|きょうさく}が{続|つづ}いた{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}には、{飢|き}きんが{何度|なんど}も{起|お}きた。
examples.english: During the Edo period, when crop failures continued, famines occurred repeatedly.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite of {豊作|ほうさく} (bumper crop, abundant harvest). Historically, {凶作|きょうさく} was a frequent cause of {飢|き}きん (famine) in Japan, particularly during the Edo period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凶作|きょうさく}になる (to have a crop failure)
- {凶作|きょうさく}が{続|つづ}く (crop failures continue)
- {凶作|きょうさく}に{見舞|みま}われる (to be hit by a bad harvest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {豊作|ほうさく}: bumper crop — the opposite, an abundant harvest
- {不作|ふさく}: poor harvest — similar meaning but somewhat milder than {凶作|きょうさく}
